definitions.explanation: The ability to respond cleverly and appropriately in the moment, especially in conversation.

examples.japanese: {機知|きち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}んだ→富む：12343_tomu⟧⟦{返答|へんとう}→返答：10440_hentou⟧だ。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{機知|きち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}んだ→富む：12343_tomu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
⟦{司会者|しかいしゃ}→司会者：20470_shikaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{機知|きち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}んだ→富む：12343_tomu⟧トーク⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: The venue was livened up by the host's witty talk.

notes:
A somewhat literary or formal word for wit and quick thinking. Almost always appears in the set phrase {機知|きち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧ (to be rich in wit).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {機知|きち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧ — to be witty, to be full of wit
- {機知|きち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}んだ→富む：12343_tomu⟧ — witty (as modifier)
- {機知|きち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}んだ→富む：12343_tomu⟧⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧ — witty conversation
- {機知|きち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}んだ→富む：12343_tomu⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧ — a witty speech

USAGE:
This word is rarely used outside the set phrase {機知|きち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧/⟦{富|と}んだ→富む：12343_tomu⟧. It is more common in written language, book reviews, and formal descriptions of people.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ユーモア→ユーモア：00432_yuumoa⟧ — humor (loanword, broader)
- ウィット — wit (loanword, same meaning)
- {頓知|とんち} — clever response, quick thinking (often associated with riddles and folk tales)
